component.name: Spelunkr Guide
component.summary: Channel surf Spelunkr's archive television network

description.p: An independent television guide for the channels at Spelunkr.tv. Browse programs with your keyboard, watch a channel, and surf up or down just like cable television.
Schedules come directly from Spelunkr and video streams directly from the Internet Archive. The original project is credited beneath the guide. No separate server is required.
